description: This file is the jQuery Validation Plugin v1.17.0, defining validation methods, rules, and behaviors for form validation in a web project.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Initializes validation on a form element, returning a validator object.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current form or element is valid according to the validation rules.

methods.name: rules
methods.description: Gets or sets validation rules for form elements.

methods.name: addMethod
methods.description: Adds a new validation method to the plugin.
